page.title: Medium under load
page.kicker: Lecture 02 · week 1, day 2 · running case: Medium
page.dek: Caching at every level, then the rest of the framework (scaling, delegation, concurrency and communication), each worked through on Medium.
page.description: Lecture 02: caching at every level, then scaling, delegation, concurrency and communication, each worked through on Medium.

chapters.title: Caching at every level
chapters.summary: Before buying more machines, stop doing the same work twice. Every box on a Medium request’s route can keep a copy of something.

chapters.title: Scaling
chapters.summary: More readers than one box can serve. What scaling means, the two directions, the spikes you can see coming, and why the database goes first.

chapters.title: Delegation
chapters.summary: Publishing a story does too much inside one request. What to take out of the request, the two kinds of broker, and the Kafka essentials you need to design with.

chapters.title: Concurrency
chapters.summary: Two readers clap at the same instant. A short taste of what goes wrong when two workers touch one number, and of the tools that keep it right.

chapters.title: Communication
chapters.summary: Show claps live to every co-reader. Request-response, polling, long polling, WebSockets and server-sent events, and which hop in Medium uses which.

chapters.title: What to keep
chapters.summary: The heuristics that recur in every section, and where this lecture stops.
